import ref
from h import run
def cmp(obj,label=''):
    got=run(obj); exp=ref.batch(obj)
    if got==exp: return True
    print('MISMATCH',label)
    for i,(g,e) in enumerate(zip(got['traces'],exp['traces'])):
        if g==e: continue
        for k in g:
            if g[k]!=e[k]:
                print(' trace',i,'key',k)
                print('  got ',json.dumps(g[k])[:1500])
                print('  exp ',json.dumps(e[k])[:1500])
        return False
    print('  got',json.dumps(got)[:800]); print('  exp',json.dumps(exp)[:800])
    return False
